sql: SELECT fished_date_t, fished_date_season, fished_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trip_count, SUM(yt) as total_yt, AVG(yt) as avg_yt_per_trip FROM trips GROUP BY fished_date_t, fished_date_season, fished_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fished_date_t DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT fished_date_t, fished_date_season, fished_date_doy, cls, SUM(yt) as total_yt FROM trips WHERE fished_date_season = 1 GROUP BY fished_date_t, fished_date_season, fished_date_doy, cls ORDER BY total_yt DESC LIMIT 30
